details: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).
